Svarasavāhī viduṣo'pi tathārūḍho'bhiniveśaḥ /II.9/
Sva-rasa-vāhī viduṣo'pi tathārūḍho'bhiniveśaḥ /II.9/

« Persistant spontanément, le vouloir-vivre demeure même chez celui qui sait. »
1042

Sarvasya prāṇina iyam ātma-āśir nityā bhavati mā na bhūvaṃ bhūyāsam iti / Na ca–
ananubhūta-maraṇa-dharmakasya–eṣā bhavaty ātma-āśiḥ / Etayā ca pūrva-janma-anubhavaḥ
pratīyate sa ca–ayam abhiniveśaḥ kleśaḥ sva-rasa-vāhī / Kṛmer api jāta-mātrasya pratyakṣa-
anumāna-āgamair
asaṃbhāvito
maraṇa-trāsa
uccheda-dṛṣṭy-ātmakaḥ,
pūrva-janma-
anubhūtaṃ maraṇa-duḥkham anumāpayati / Yathā ca–ayam atyanta-mūḍheṣu dṛśyate kleśas
tathā viduṣo'pi vijñāta-pūrva-apara-
